title: The Rostov Ripper Murders
evidence: Physical and forensic evidence connected Chikatilo to multiple victims
Police investigation linked him to a large series of disappearances and murders
A psychiatric evaluation was conducted at the Serbsky Institute before trial
modus_operandi: Chikatilo approached vulnerable women and children, often near transportation hubs, markets, and other public locations. He lured victims to secluded areas where he sexually assaulted and murdered them, frequently inflicting extensive physical injuries.
personality_disorder: A psychiatric evaluation conducted at the Serbsky Institute concluded that Chikatilo had Borderline Personality Disorder with sadistic features. The evaluation nevertheless found him competent to stand trial.
summary: Soviet serial killer convicted of murdering 52 people. His forensic psychiatric evaluation identified Borderline Personality Disorder with sadistic features while finding him legally competent to stand trial.
